key_contracts: No-contract ADMIT remains historical and is not reinterpreted.
Existing schema-v1 contract is accepted only when its binding digest equals the exact frozen current compliance-runtime binding.
Schema-v2 accepts only allowlisted binding_id values with exact frozen digest; arbitrary caller binding values are rejected.
A replay_authorized_v1 ADMIT paired with missing/current-v1 RESERVE provenance fails closed; current-v1 ADMIT paired with replay-v2 RESERVE also fails closed.
Registry authority is stored as canonical JSON strings and binding_for_id returns fresh decoded copies, preventing accidental in-process mutation of the canonical registry object.
limitations: This module resolves provenance versions but is not yet wired into the runtime auditor or CLOSE/replay.
The existing schema-v1 contract's exact binding is frozen from the current role-local compliance runtime source; changes require a new binding id/version rather than mutation.
No arbitrary external binding registry is accepted by design.
